summary: Three rules stated once per file (retro's docs/solutions commit does not void the approval and the merger proves it with jj diff --summary quoted in READY; a conflict-forced rebase with an unchanged fingerprint is a confirmation (tester bare gates, reviewer approves the new head by SHA or continues its round, merger republishes READY), only a changed diff restarts the full review; no handoff file after the .legion deletion, report with legion handoff complete alone) plus a daemon change so an implementer completion writes testing only from in_progress.
workflowRecommendation: One implementer, three path-scoped commits in order (daemon TDD first, then the three skills, then the four role prompts), one PR. Text edits share no file across commits, so no hunk sequencing is needed. Run tests from packages/daemon, not the repo root.

rules: Retro's commit does not void the approval: after the reviewer approves the cleaned head, retro commits only docs/solutions/ on top; the tree goes to the merger, never back to tester or reviewer. Merger proves it with `jj diff --from <approved-sha> --to <tip-sha> --summary` quoted in READY and refuses if `... --summary '~docs/solutions'` prints anything.

An unchanged-diff rebase is a confirmation, not a round: rebase only when GitHub reports CONFLICTING; each role compares the fingerprint at the head it last verified with the new head; equal -> tester bare gates only (CI green at new head + repository smoke), reviewer APPROVEs the new head by SHA if previously approved else continues its round, merger republishes READY, retro never re-runs; different -> full review restarts.
No handoff file after the .legion deletion: later rebase, re-check, confirmation, or retro writes no .legion/<phase>.json and reports with `legion handoff complete` alone.

unchangedDiffCheck.command: cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" git fetch && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" diff --from "fork_point(main@origin | <head-sha>)" --to <head-sha> --git --context 0 '~.legion' '~docs/solutions' | sed -e '/^@@/d' -e '/^index /d' | sha256sum
unchangedDiffCheck.verified: jj 0.45.1: --from/--to/--git/--context 0/--summary accepted; fork_point() resolves; a hidden (rebased-away) head is addressable by SHA in the shared workspace; fileset negation ~docs/solutions works; jj warns on stderr `No matching entries for paths: .legion` once .legion is gone (hash unaffected)
unchangedDiffCheck.unresolvableOldHead: counts as a changed diff (no silent fallback)
